planting.note: Plant container or balled-and-burlapped trees in spring in full sun to light shade; mulch to keep roots cool as with all birches.

directions: Plant in full sun to light shade in medium-moisture, well-drained soil in spring, mulching to keep roots cool like other Himalayan birches. Grayswood Ghost is prized as one of the whitest-barked jacquemontii selections, with chalky white trunks and branches that color up remarkably early on young trees compared to seed-grown stock. It forms a vigorous, upright oval tree with glossy dark green summer foliage that turns clear yellow in autumn, and it has earned the Royal Horticultural Society's Award of Garden Merit for its outstanding winter bark display. Give it room as a specimen or small grove planting, since its vigorous growth and bright bark are best appreciated away from crowding by other trees.
